$comment: Checks in jdk-differential.test.ts that fail today, each tied to the roadmap issue (#3) that should fix it.
Listed checks run as it.fails(): the suite stays green, and turns red when a fix makes one pass. Delete the entry then.
"issues": what the failure is waiting on, main issue first. "reason": the symptom, in a few words.
See the details of any case with: npx tsx scripts/java-diff.ts <case id>

collections/coll-foreach-lambda.reason: List.forEach needs a lambda, and lambdas are rejected until #16

collections/coll-list-remove-object-vs-i.reason: list.remove(Integer.valueOf(40)) removes by index instead of by value: Integer.valueOf returns an int here, so remove(int) is chosen

collections/coll-map-computeIfAbsent.reason: Map.computeIfAbsent needs a lambda, and lambdas are rejected until #16

collections/coll-map-merge.reason: Map.merge with Integer::sum needs a method reference, rejected until #16

collections/coll-priorityqueue-comparato.reason: the PriorityQueue comparator is a lambda, rejected until #16

collections/coll-sort-comparator-lambda.reason: the List.sort comparator is a lambda, rejected until #16

compile-errors/ce-lossy-conversion.reason: runs int n = <double>, which javac rejects (possible lossy conversion)

compile-errors/ce-missing-return.reason: runs a method with a missing return statement

compile-errors/ce-string-minus.reason: reports "5" - 1 (bad operand types) when that line runs, not before the program starts

compile-errors/ce-type-mismatch.reason: runs int x = "hello", which javac rejects (incompatible types)

compile-errors/ce-undeclared-var-late.reason: runs until it reaches an undeclared variable javac reports before running

compile-errors/ce-uninitialized-local.reason: reports the read of a never-assigned local when that line runs, not before the program starts

core/deep-recursion.reason: recursion 900 deep overflows the JavaScript stack

core/integer-cache.reason: Integer == ignores the -128..127 cache: boxed values have no identity until static types (#13) know where boxing happens

core/num-ternary-promotion.reason: a conditional with int and double branches doesn't promote to double

core/overload-by-type.reason: overloads are chosen by argument count, not type

core/overload-ctor-by-type.reason: constructor overloads are chosen by argument count, not type

extra/boxed-identity-eq.reason: Integer == compares values, ignoring the -128..127 cache

misc/misc-string-methods-more.reason: String.chars() returns a stream, rejected until #16

oop/oop-custom-iterable.reason: for-each over a user Iterable, and its anonymous Iterator, are rejected until #16

oop/oop-inner-class-outer-field.reason: creating an inner class through an object (m.new Walker()) is rejected until #16

oop/oop-interface-default-method.reason: interface default methods are rejected until #15

oop/oop-super-method-call.reason: inheritance (extends) and super.method() are rejected until #15
